bio_en: Hello, I'm Benze, Founder and CEO of KCVA. I specialize in tournament operations and strategic partnerships, bringing an avant-garde vision to the international school sports scene. As a decisive leader and referee, I thrive in managing high-stakes coordination and ensuring seamless execution from the boardroom to the court.
bio_zh: 大家好，我是 Benze，KCVA 创始人兼 CEO。我负责赛事运营与战略合作，为国际学校体育场景带来前卫视野。作为果断的领导者与裁判，我擅长高压协调，确保从会议室到赛场的每一个环节无缝执行。

bio_en: As KCVA's CTO, Tony oversees the official website and coordinates reliable technical and media delivery across KCVA events.
bio_zh: 作为 KCVA CTO，Tony 负责官方网站，并统筹赛事技术与媒体执行。

bio_en: Katherine oversees KCVA operations, cross-team coordination and on-site management to keep each event running smoothly.
bio_zh: Katherine 负责 KCVA 运营、跨团队协调与现场管理，保障赛事顺畅进行。

bio_en: Ivory coordinates communication with schools, venues and event partners, helping KCVA collaborations move forward clearly and efficiently.
bio_zh: Ivory 负责学校、场地及活动合作方的沟通协调，推动 KCVA 合作清晰高效地进行。

bio_en: Susanna leads KCVA's marketing and business work, coordinating partner communication, sponsorship planning and the presentation of each tournament to schools and supporters.
bio_zh: Susanna 负责 KCVA 的市场与商务工作，统筹合作方沟通、赞助策划以及赛事面向学校和支持者的整体呈现。

bio_en: Jiarui supports KCVA's business team through partner communication, sponsorship follow-ups and event preparation, helping turn collaboration ideas into clear and practical actions.
bio_zh: Jiarui 负责协助 KCVA 商务部进行合作方沟通、赞助跟进与赛事筹备，将合作想法转化为清晰可执行的任务。

bio_en: Abby supports KCVA as Host 2 and an on-site volleyball coordinator, bringing practical team and club experience to event delivery.
bio_zh: Abby 担任 KCVA 主持 2 及线下排球协调工作，将校队与社团经验带入赛事执行。

bio_en: Justin supports KCVA's business operations, assisting with partner follow-ups, materials coordination and practical preparation before each event.
bio_zh: Justin 协助 KCVA 商务运营，负责合作跟进、物料协调及赛事前期的具体筹备工作。

bio_en: Chris supports on-site execution, including venue setup, equipment coordination and keeping event-day operations aligned with the schedule.
bio_zh: Chris 负责线下执行，包括场地布置、器材协调以及按赛程推进比赛日现场工作。

bio_en: Courtney serves as a KCVA host and on-site staff member, guiding the event programme and keeping transitions, announcements and participant communication clear.
bio_zh: Courtney 担任 KCVA 主持及线下工作人员，负责推进活动流程，并确保环节衔接、现场播报及参赛沟通清晰顺畅。

bio_en: Alissa is a member of the KCVA team. More details about her role will be added soon.
bio_zh: Alissa 是 KCVA 团队成员，具体职责介绍即将补充。
